item.title: Logan Paul’s Pikachu Illustrator Pokémon card sells for record $16.5M at auction
item.description: NEW YORK — Logan Paul has set a new world's record — for the auction price of a trading card.The wrestling and social media star's rare Pickachu Illustrator Pokémon card, a “Holy Grail” for collectors, sold for $16.5 million Monday at Goldin Auctions after 41 days of bidding. Paul had purchased the card in 2021 for $5.275 million, a Guinness record at the time for a Pokémon card.
